prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a 16-bit side-scrolling beat-em-up, Streets-of-Rage-inspired illustrated pixel art. Create NIKO, a bald male special agent with dark sunglasses, black mustache and small soul patch, bright crimson red long-sleeved shirt under a BLACK tactical vest, black trousers and black shoes. Athletic average build, neither huge nor skinny, confident cocky relaxed martial artist, medium tan skin. Entire body always visible. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 isolated full-body frames on genuinely transparent background, no grid/no labels/no text/no shadows/no glow. Uniform character size and baseline in each equal 384x384 cell, atlas1536x1536. All facing RIGHT in side/three-quarter game view. Row1: relaxed confident guard idle; controlled walk left-foot planted; controlled walk right-foot planted; short running stride. Row2: opposite running stride; straight palm strike at chest height; second palm strike extended; front kick at waist height. Row3: knees bent with both hands drawn back Thunder Palms preparation; BOTH palms thrust straight forward; compact defensive sidestep low stance; strong forearm blocking stance. Row4: compact jumping kick (body same size); hurt recoil; flat on back defeated lying horizontally; kneeling recovery. Preserve bald head/shades/mustache/soul patch and black vest/red shirt costume in EVERY pose. Clean alpha cutouts with no overlap and plenty of transparent cell gutters. Pixel edges and shading, visually detailed but crisp.
